reasoning: Left join preserves all customers; unmatched customers have no orders
business_context: A left join was selected because our analysis goals require evaluating the entire customer population (including newly registered users with 0 orders). Using an inner join would introduce survival bias by omitting non-purchasing customers.
orphan_handling_policy: Orphaned orders (50 records) were logged to output/unmatched_orders.csv for data engineering investigation. They were excluded from customer metrics to avoid corrupting customer-level aggregations.
